evals.expected_output: A findings report, one line per finding in the form <file>:<line> - SEVERITY - problem. fix., covering: auth (PARTNER_SHARED_SECRET is checked before the Supabase client is created or any data is touched, on the one non-OPTIONS code path — no finding needed there); CORS (OPTIONS handled before the secret check, headers present on both the success and the 500 error path, but corsHeaders' own wildcard-fallback branch — falling back to a literal "*" when ALLOWED_ORIGINS is empty — flagged rather than assumed safe just because an allowlist exists); data access (no select("*"), but createClient(...) is untyped even though supabase/functions/_shared/database.types.ts already exists, so it should be createClient<Database>(...)); validation (validatePayload's hand-rolled shape checks are noted alongside their own documented cold-start-latency rationale and the fact that zod isn't in deno.json's imports map, with a recommendation to add zod rather than either ignoring the rationale or ignoring the missing dependency); error handling (errors are logged via console.error and only a generic "sync failed" message reaches the caller — no finding needed there); documentation (buildSyncPlan, the densest logic in _lib.ts — dedup by sku plus quantity clamping — has no doc comment, unlike validatePayload which explains its own rationale); and testability (logic lives in _lib.ts, index.test.ts exercises buildSyncPlan directly without mocking the Supabase client). No rewriting of the function, no praise, no vague findings.
expectations: Findings are reported one per line as <file>:<line> - SEVERITY - problem. fix., not as prose or a rewrite of the function
Confirms the shared secret is checked before the Supabase client is created or any data is touched, on the one non-OPTIONS code path
Flags corsHeaders' wildcard-fallback branch (falling back to a literal "*" origin when ALLOWED_ORIGINS is empty) rather than treating the allowlist check as automatically safe
Flags createClient(...) as untyped and recommends createClient<Database>(...), since supabase/functions/_shared/database.types.ts already exists

Notes validatePayload's hand-rolled validation together with its documented cold-start-latency rationale and zod's absence from deno.json's imports map, recommending zod be added rather than issuing a blanket 'switch to zod' finding that ignores either fact
Confirms errors are logged (console.error) and only a generic message reaches the caller — does not flag error handling as swallowing or leaking
Flags buildSyncPlan in _lib.ts for missing a doc comment despite being the densest business logic (dedup by sku, quantity clamping)
Confirms testability: logic lives in _lib.ts and index.test.ts exercises it directly without mocking the Supabase client
Does not rewrite the function and does not include praise or findings that don't change behavior or risk
